approvalSource: User approved all twelve Hinglish recommendations in this conversation
purpose: Record approved initial policies and update Phase1 drafts only. Original approved docs remain unchanged. This approval does not authorize application implementation, dependency installation or commits.

decisions.topic: Canonical scene registry and legacy names
decisions.baselineContext: HLD section 7 and Database Design section 3.5 use TITLE, STEPS, STACK_QUEUE, FLOWCHART, COMPARISON, TIMELINE, KEY_POINTS, IMAGE_WITH_LABELS and CHARACTER_PRESENTER_2D. Pipeline section 4 uses different illustrative names.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Use the canonical nine-template registry and reject legacy aliases at input. First develop/test TITLE, STEPS, STACK_QUEUE, FLOWCHART and KEY_POINTS. Activate other templates only after tests; CHARACTER_PRESENTER_2D remains gated P1.
verification: Unknown templates and legacy field names fail schema validation.
Repeated template types are allowed, but sceneId values must be unique by semantic validation.

decisions.topic: Scene and input limits and template props
decisions.baselineContext: API section 6, HLD section 7 and Database Design section 3.5 require bounded scenes, text and per-template visualProps, but do not fully define their schemas. DB illustrative project limits are title 120 and prompt 2000 characters.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Adopt existing draft bounds as initial upper limits: 2-18 scenes, prompt 2000 characters, title 120, and strict bounded per-template props. Inert text and owner-resolved IDs only; bounds do not guarantee layout or spoken duration.
verification: Valid and invalid examples exercise every template.
Long text, unsupported props, executable fields, raw media URLs and unsafe reference values are rejected or handled by the documented semantic checks.

decisions.baselineContext: API uses estimatedDurationSec; pipeline sections 2, 5 and 7 require measured audio durations, integer-frame composition and no silent clipping. Target tolerance of plus/minus 5 seconds is provisional.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Initial 1280x720,30FPS and target tolerance plus/minus5seconds. Measure speech, use integer timing/ceiling frame count and contiguous scenes. Sensible small pauses only; large mismatch fails with revision-required error, new draft and approval. No clipping or unnatural speedup.
verification: Timeline covers all measured speech without clipping.
Total duration and transition overlap are checked semantically.
Revised narration never renders under the old approval hash.

decisions.baselineContext: PRD FR-017 requires synchronized captions; UI/UX section 4E requests a captions toggle. API and DB currently describe MP4 and existing asset kinds without a subtitle asset contract.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Deliver a clean MP4 plus separate owner-authorized WebVTT caption asset from the same timeline. Browser toggle and separate downloads; MP4 alone has no captions. Reuse existing asset delivery route; burned-in export deferred.
verification: A burned-in-only export cannot be described as supporting a captions toggle.
Future caption delivery must preserve ownership, retention and timing invariants.

decisions.baselineContext: Approved stack uses Gemini planning, preferred local Kokoro and Remotion. API settings illustrate EDUCATIONAL tone and MOTION_GRAPHICS style; exact voice presets and broader enumerations are open.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Preferred local Kokoro, one tested English voice, EDUCATIONAL tone and MOTION_GRAPHICS. Defer public voice selector. Extra voices,Hindi,vertical and character remain gated until quality tests; no automatic cloud fallback.
verification: Capability checks run in addition to schema enum checks.
Internal TTS configuration cannot be supplied as arbitrary provider commands or paths by a client.

decisions.baselineContext: API section 7 scopes idempotency to authenticated user, endpoint/action and key; DB section 3.6 records owner/action/key hashes and a canonical request digest. The 24-hour window is a proposal.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Protect repeated requests for24hours. Keep owner/action/key namespace and route-target-inclusive request fingerprint. Matching request replays original admission receipt/job without new reservation; changed body/target conflicts. Poll for live state; preserve job history independently.
verification: Same key/body/target returns the original generationId without another reservation.
Changing payload or route target conflicts.
Replay still succeeds when the original job is active, complete or the worker is now offline.

decisions.baselineContext: Database Design section 3.8 defines UTC daily usage buckets and leaves reserve/consume/refund policy open. Section 4 requires atomic or reconciled bucket/job writes.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Initial configurable demo:3 generation slots/user/dayUTC,1 running+2 waiting globally,1 active/project. Reserve1 slot/new admission for any duration. Success consumes; system/provider failure releases; user cancellation before rendering releases and after render start consumes. Job-linked reservations and transaction-capable atomic admission.
verification: Concurrent submissions never exceed admitted capacity.
Crashes between reservation, job insert and settlement are recoverable.
Dedupe and repeated settlement cannot double-charge or double-refund.

decisions.baselineContext: API sections 7 and 10 and DB section 3.6 define six statuses, six stages, leases/fencing, cooperative cancellation and new-job retries.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Initial configurable heartbeat10s,renewable lease60s,max2 automatic execution attempts total. Fresh fencing prevents stale publication and workers stop owned processes. First guarded cancel/completion commit wins; CANCELLED only after actual stop. User retry is a new admission; stage timeouts follow duration benchmarks.
verification: A stale worker cannot publish after reclaim, cancellation or deletion.
CANCELLED is recorded only after stop/cleanup is confirmed.
Transient lease recovery retains the job identity; user retry creates a new identity.

decisions.topic: Private media range delivery and revocation
decisions.baselineContext: API section 8 permits an authenticated stream or short-lived redirect and requires immediate access revocation. Signed URLs of at most 60 seconds are proposed; browser range playback is required to work.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Private local files with owner-authenticated byte-range streaming initially; signed URLs deferred. New reads check owner,deletion,expiry. Successful intermediates clean after verified delivery; failed temp artifacts max24h; video+caption exports expire together7days after verified publication. Deletion immediately blocks new reads; already-delivered bytes cannot be revoked.
verification: Every new read/range request checks owner and deletion state.
Cross-user reads and stale asset links cannot bypass authorization.
Range boundaries and expired redirects behave consistently in supported browsers.

decisions.topic: Frozen input and reproducible execution provenance
decisions.baselineContext: Pipeline sections 1 and 6 require reproducible renders and immutable render versions; DB requires approved storyboard/settings hashes and forbids exposing hashes/leases/storage keys in public serializers.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Freeze approved narration/settings and retain a separate internal execution recipe with engine/template versions,TTS model/voice,audio hashes,timeline,fonts,encoding and published video/caption hashes. Reuse verified audio only for matching text,voice,model/settings; no unconditional cross-environment byte guarantee.
verification: Public job responses reject internal lease/hash/path fields.
Retries cannot silently reuse audio from different text/voice/model inputs.
A retained manifest identifies the artifacts and versions needed to reproduce an export.

decisions.baselineContext: API sections 2, 3 and 11 require httpOnly JWT/refresh cookies, token rotation, CSRF/Origin checks and strict CORS. Cookie names, lifetimes, password limits and final hostname deployment are not fixed.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Same-origin initial deployment; productionHTTPS,httpOnly/Secure cookies,explicitSameSite,CSRF/Origin and no-store. Access15min; rotating refresh7days; logoutrevokes refresh and clears cookies; no tokens in localStorage. Password-only signup15-128characters.
verification: No bearer-token or localStorage workflow is implied.
Refresh authenticates via refresh session even when access expires.
Mutations fail Origin/CSRF checks; cookie clearing exactly matches issuing scope.

decisions.topic: Incomplete API shapes and gated surface
decisions.baselineContext: API provides approved methods/paths and illustrative bodies but leaves detailed list/usage/deletion/cancellation/reporting shapes and several field limits unspecified. Fork and character upload remain P1/gated.
decisions.approvedRecommendation: Preserve32 approved methods/paths and consistent envelopes/errors/pagination. Generation settings changed after approval require new draft/review/approval; title-only changes do not. Preserve prior snapshots/outputs; never mix new settings with old approval. Direct prompt PATCH deferred; explain disabledP1 features.
verification: Every approved endpoint is represented, including assistant-history pagination.
Every local schema reference resolves and examples match the selected draft schema.
Server-owned fields are absent from client write schemas and secrets absent from public responses.
